en: A sepia-toned postcard depicting a central town square with historic European buildings in the background. The foreground features a large fountain with a statue at the center, around which several people are walking and standing. The square is spacious, with cobblestone paving. Several signs in German are visible on the buildings, and the architecture features steeply gabled roofs, characteristic of medieval Germany.
